About this property

Urbanrise Paradise on Earth is the latest luxury residential villa project launched off Kanakapura Road, South Bangalore. The residential enclave Urbanrise Paradise on Earth Villas is spread across a massive 24-acre land full of lush greens and features the very best in Urbanrise (Alliance Group)’s luxury living segment. The project offers spacious luxury 4 BHK eco-sustainable villas with luxurious features. Private gardens for each villa, 1500+ trees in 24 acres of green space, and Beautiful landscapes around Urbanrise Paradise on Earth make it more special and elite. The builder is guaranteed to bring a quality living experience to the community of Kanakapura Road, South Bangalore with brilliant architecture, state-of-the-art sustainable features, nature-themed amenities, and an equivalent lifestyle in Urbanrise Paradise on Earth Villas.
